Where should we store the spare parts for the conveyor belt?
In the cabinet next to the loading dock.
The conveyor belt stopped working at noon.
They are very expensive spare parts, I believe.
When does the night shift start at the plant?
Yes, the new shift supervisor is very friendly.
At ten o'clock, the same as every evening.
The plant needs a lot more water this summer.
You've switched off the main generator before leaving, haven't you?
The main entrance is open until seven tonight.
Yes, I turned it off and locked the control room.
The generator was built in nineteen ninety-eight.
Who is in charge of the safety inspection this month?
Safety goggles are on the shelf by the door.
The inspection usually takes about two hours.
Ms. Ortega from the maintenance team is responsible.
Could you check whether the delivery truck has arrived at gate three?
It was delivered in a large green box.
The gate is made of steel and concrete.
Of course, I'll go and look right now.
How long has the new turbine been running at full capacity?
Yes, it is a very large turbine.
Since the beginning of March, without any problem.
It runs at about forty kilometres an hour.
Why was the shipment of steel pipes delayed last week?
A storm closed the port for two full days.
Yes, the pipes were shipped by sea.
I'll pay the steel supplier next week.
Our energy bill went up by fifteen percent last quarter, didn't it?
It's cheaper to heat the offices in summer.
Yes, mostly because of the new cooling system.
Fifteen workers joined the team in May.
If the supplier doesn't confirm by Friday, what will we do?
The supplier is based in southern Poland.
I confirmed the order on Friday afternoon.
We'll switch to our second supplier.
Do you mind if I park the forklift behind the warehouse?
Not at all, there's plenty of room back there.
The warehouse opens at six every morning.
Forklifts need a special driving licence.
Which pump needs to be replaced, the old one or the new one?
Yes, the new pump is much quieter.
The one in the basement, because it's leaking.
A replacement part costs two hundred euros.
The container ship is scheduled to arrive on the twelfth of June.
Twelve boxes are already on the ship.
I scheduled a meeting about it with Anna.
Then we should book the trucks for the thirteenth.
How much does it cost to ship one pallet to Rotterdam?
About one hundred and eighty euros.
Pallets are usually made of wood.
It takes three days to reach Rotterdam.
Isn't the solar farm supposed to open this spring?
The spring inside this valve is worn out.
I always plant flowers in spring.
It was, but the permits are still pending.
Where can I find the maintenance schedule for the production line?
The production line makes car doors.
Maintenance costs are lower this year.
It's posted on the board by the exit.
We'd better reduce the machine's speed before the safety check.
Agreed, I'll turn it down right now.
The safety check was signed yesterday.
The speed limit on the motorway is ninety.
Has the new electricity meter been installed yet?
Yes, the meeting was installed last week.
The technician is coming tomorrow morning.
The meter reads three hundred units today.
Should we ship the goods by air or by sea this time?
By sea is cheaper, and we have enough time.
We shipped the goods last week.
The air in the warehouse is very dry.
Is rail transport cheaper than road transport for this route?
Transport costs are listed on page three.
The road is closed after eight o'clock.
Yes, by about thirty percent, but it takes longer.
How many trucks are loaded at the depot each morning?
Usually about twelve, but it varies.
The depot is closed on Sundays.
Our new battery plant will open next year, won't it?
Yes, I need a new battery for my phone.
The plant on the windowsill needs some water.
That's the plan, if the permits come through.
Please make sure the loading bay is clear before the trucks arrive.
The trucks arrive from the north.
The bay is the largest in the region.
I'll move the last pallets right away.
Whose turn is it to check the pressure gauges this week?
I checked into the hotel on Monday.
I think it's Daniel's, but I'll confirm.
The pressure at work is very high.
Why don't we reduce the speed of the conveyor for the new product?
The conveyor was installed last week.
I don't know why the speed is so fast.
That would help, but it would also slow production.
Where was the new transformer delivered this morning?
To the east gate, since the main road was blocked.
The delivery driver was very friendly.
Yes, the transformer is extremely powerful.
Morning, Karen. I heard line two stopped again during the night.
Yes, a temperature sensor failed around three a.m. The night crew replaced it, but they lost almost two hours of production.
That's the third time this month. Should we order a whole batch of sensors?
I already asked the supplier. They can send twenty units next Thursday, and I'll ask for a discount because of the volume.
Good. I'll update the maintenance log and let the plant manager know.
Thanks for meeting me, Mr. Evans. I've finished the energy audit of your factory.
And what did you find? We've noticed the electricity bills rising since last winter.
The compressors run all night, even when nobody is working. If you install timers, you could save around twelve percent.
That sounds reasonable. What about the lighting?
Switching to LED lights would cost more at first, but it pays for itself within two years.
Please send me a written quote, and I'll discuss it with the board on Monday.
Tom, the driver just called. The road to the distribution centre is closed because of flooding.
Then let's send the trucks through Harlow instead.
That adds about ninety kilometres. I thought it would be too far, but we don't have another option.
Actually, there's a ferry crossing near Denby that saves thirty of those. Let me check its timetable.
Good idea. And I'll warn the customer that the delivery will be a day late.
Let's begin with the new safety rules. Maria, can you explain the helmet policy?
Certainly. From next Monday, everyone entering the production hall must wear a helmet, including visitors and delivery drivers.
Will the company provide the helmets?
Yes, we've ordered two hundred, and they'll be kept at the main gate.
And what about the training session?
It's optional for office staff, but compulsory for anyone who works near the machines.
I've received eleven applications for the maintenance technician position.
Three of them have worked on wind turbines before. I'll invite them for interviews next week.
Please make sure the interview panel includes someone from the safety team.
Of course. By the time the interviews are over, we'll have contacted all the references.
Good. We need the new person to start before the summer overhaul.
I'm calling about invoice 4471. We were charged for forty pallets, but we only received thirty-five.
Let me check. Ah, I see. Five pallets were left at the depot because the truck was full.
So we haven't been delivered the full order, and yet we've paid for all of it.
That's right, and I apologise. I'll issue a credit note today, and the remaining pallets will go out on Wednesday.
Thank you. Could you email me the credit note?
Hello, this is Priya from SunBright. We're ready to install your solar panels.
Great. I was hoping you could come before the weekend.
We're planning to start on Thursday, but that depends on the weather. If it rains, we'll move to Monday.
Do I need to be at home?
Not the whole day, but someone should be there at eight to unlock the roof hatch.
My neighbour has a spare key, so she can help.
Has the customs form for the Lagos shipment been signed yet?
Not yet. The exporter sent the wrong invoice, so I'm waiting for the correct version.
The container leaves port at six tomorrow evening. If the form isn't ready by noon, we'll miss it.
I know. I'll phone the exporter again and ask for it to be emailed within the hour.
If that fails, we'll book the next sailing, on Sunday.
We have a booth at the Energy Expo in Hamburg in October. Who's coming?
I plan to go, and I'd like to bring the new heat pump demo.
I can't join until Wednesday, since I have a client visit on Tuesday.
That's fine. The expo lasts four days, so we can rotate.
The shipping company says the demo unit needs ten days to arrive, so we should send it next week.
Our diesel costs are higher than last year. The new supplier charges one euro forty per litre.
That's more expensive than the old one. Why did we switch?
They offered a longer delivery contract, but I think the old supplier was cheaper overall.
Let's ask both for new quotes. The cheapest one will get the contract.
I'll collect the quotes by Friday and compare them.
The new inventory app keeps crashing when I scan the barcodes.
Did you update it? Version three fixed that problem. You need to turn it off and start it up again after the update.
I'll try. By the way, the system doesn't count the items on the top shelves.
That's because the scanner can't reach them. We should buy a longer scanner, or you can type in the numbers by hand.
I'll look into prices and let you know.
I'd like to talk about next month's shift schedule. Although the orders are growing, we have two people on leave.
Then we'll need overtime, unless we hire temporary staff.
Overtime is expensive, whereas temporary staff need training. Maybe we could combine both.
That's reasonable. I'll ask the agency for three temporary workers, and we'll offer limited overtime in the meantime.
Fine, as long as it's voluntary.
How is the wind farm project going?
We have the construction permit, but the local council wants a noise study first.
Will that delay the start of the work?
Probably by three weeks. The survey company can begin on the ninth, and they need ten working days.
Then the first turbines won't go up before the end of July.
Right. I'll update the schedule and send it to the investors.

Attention all production staff. Line three will be shut down from two o'clock this afternoon for scheduled maintenance. Workers on that line should report to the training room in building B, where a safety refresher will be held. If you are not sure which team you belong to, check the board near the cafeteria. Normal production will resume tomorrow at six a.m.

Hello, this is Elena from Norbridge Metals, calling about your order of copper wire. I'm afraid the shipment will arrive two days late because our truck broke down near Leeds. The new delivery date is Thursday the fourteenth. If that causes a problem, please call me back on extension fifty-two, and I can arrange a partial delivery by courier on Wednesday.

Welcome to the Alder Valley hydroelectric plant. During the next hour, we'll walk through the control room, then visit the turbine hall, where you'll see the water pushing the blades. Please stay behind the yellow lines, and don't take photographs inside the control room. Photos are fine outdoors. At the end, there will be a short film in the visitor centre.

Looking for reliable equipment? At Bolt and Lift Rentals, you can hire a forklift for as little as eighty dollars a day. All machines are serviced every month, and our drivers can deliver within three hours. This week only, rent for five days and get the sixth day free. Visit our website or call today.

This is the morning transport update. Trucks heading to the Port of Calder should expect delays of up to ninety minutes, because one of the two entrance gates is closed for repairs. The port authority recommends using the northern gate and booking a time slot online. Drivers who arrive without a reservation may be asked to wait in the parking area. Normal operations should resume on Friday.

Good morning, everyone. Before we start, I have good news. Thanks to the new heat recovery system, our energy consumption dropped by eight percent this quarter. However, we're still short of our target of ten percent, so the next step is to replace the old lighting in the east wing. The project manager will send the schedule by Friday, and each department should name one person to coordinate.

Good evening, everyone. Tonight we celebrate Henry Marsh, who retires after thirty-two years at Cresta Engines. Henry started as an apprentice and ended as head of quality. He designed the testing method we still use today, which cut our returns by half. Please join me in raising a glass to Henry, and don't forget the dessert table is open.

Thank you for calling Delta Freight Services. For shipment tracking, press one. To schedule a pickup, press two. If you would like to report damaged goods, press three. For billing questions, press four. Our offices are open Monday to Friday from eight to six. If you know the extension of the person you wish to reach, you may dial it at any time.

Welcome to today's webinar on predictive maintenance. My name is Dr. Lena Park, and I'll show how sensors can warn you before a machine fails. The session will last forty-five minutes, followed by a question period. You can type your questions in the chat box at any time. A recording will be sent to all registered participants tomorrow, along with the slides.

In business news, the government announced that electricity prices for factories will fall by six percent from January. The decision follows a rise in wind and solar production. Industry groups welcomed the news but said more investment in the grid is needed. Meanwhile, Orlan Steel announced it will reopen its second furnace next month, creating about two hundred jobs.
